name: Group by Angle
description: Gives each smooth region of the active piece its own face group, splitting where the surface bends more sharply than an angle. Shows the result before you accept it.

params.label: Angle (degrees)
params.help: Faces that meet more sharply than this are put in different groups. Flat areas stay together.

params.label: Keep existing splits
params.help: Faces that already have different groups stay apart, even when the surface between them is smooth.

params.text: Each smooth patch becomes a face group. Ctrl+Shift+click one to isolate it.
